headline: Ansar Allah missile strike on Aden Badr Camp
dek: Ansar Allah spox Yahya Saree claims ballistic-missile strike Wednesday morning on coalition 'operations room' at Badr Camp, Aden; blast heard near airport; police official + 2 AFP security sources corroborate strike on coalition site near airport. Separately, Saudi-led coalition spox Turki al-Malki…
fault_line: Who's lying about Medina? A holy-city strike claim vs flat denial — fault line: trust in coalition vs Ansar Allah statements; IG post Oct 21 08:47 UTC drew 1.2K likes/210 comments.

sections.what_happened: Ansar Allah spox Yahya Saree claims ballistic-missile strike Wednesday morning on coalition 'operations room' at Badr Camp, Aden; blast heard near airport; police official + 2 AFP security sources corroborate strike on coalition site near airport. Separately, Saudi-led coalition spox Turki al-Malki claims 5 drones intercepted over Medina + Eastern region; Ansar Allah explicitly DENY via Reuters: 'have not launched any drones towards Medina... and have not conducted any military operations towards Saudi Arabia.' Direct contradiction. Coalition spox describes situation 'very dangerous', intensive air cover, ongoing clashes.
sections.what_verified: Aden strike: Al Jazeera (police official, AFP security sources). Medina denial: Reuters 09:45 UTC quotes Saree verbatim; syndicated widely (Straits Times etc.).
sections.what_disputed: Coalition claims 5 intercepts incl. Medina; Ansar Allah deny — one side is false, currently unverifiable. Toll dispute persists: Shabwa camp — dpa via Qatar Tribune 53 killed/200+ injured vs Reuters 73 killed. Yemeni army claims 744 strikes on Ansar Allah in 24h; Ansar Allah claim 93 Saudi strikes; 2,793 total since escalation.
sections.why_matters: The second front escalates: third Ansar Allah strike on Aden in a week (presidential palace Tuesday, airport Friday, Badr Camp today) + first holy-city claim/denial. Fair framing: present BOTH claims labeled, never assert Medina as fact. Map: Aden/Red Sea corridor.
sections.context: Background: Yemen — Ansar Allah missile strike on Aden Badr Camp; coalition claims Medina drone intercepts, Ansar Allah DENY (contradiction)
